products.title: USB Rechargeable Fabric Shaver
products.physicalInvariants: Dark green elongated handle, copper-colored circular power button, black round head housing with perforated silver circular shaving grille. White USB cable; two white spare circular cutters and small black brush visible in inset. One appliance.
products.generationConstraints: Use both references; do not invent extra blades, ports, performance or accessories beyond visible inset.

products.title: 5-in-1 Rechargeable Cleaning Brush
products.physicalInvariants: White handheld T-shaped rotary brush: short cylindrical motor head, round white bristle face, long straight handle with gray oval control and ribbed cap. Yellow sponge disk, white fluffy pad, white bracket and short white USB cable in first inset. One appliance.
products.generationConstraints: Second photo crops same appliance without inset; use first inset for attachments, do not invent five distinct unseen attachment shapes.

products.title: Everyday Travel Organizer Pouch
products.physicalInvariants: Rectangular soft zippered pouch, blue-gray cartoon animal print with yellow/orange accents, black piping/zipper, tan horizontal webbing handle, silver reflective grid lining. One pouch.
products.generationConstraints: Pink lunchbox inside is a prop, not an included product. Keep bag design and lining; avoid converting it into a hard lunchbox.

products.title: 2-in-1 Soap Dispensing Cleaning Brush
products.physicalInvariants: Pink palm-sized bear-face brush body with two round ears, printed eyes/nose and dark-pink belly oval, side white fill-cap/button, dense gray bristle base. One brush.
products.generationConstraints: Yellow gloves and clear spray bottle are props. Preserve molded face and pink body, no pump/nozzle invention.

products.title: Microfiber Cleaning Cloth — 40 × 40 cm
products.physicalInvariants: Square terry-texture cloth, rounded corners, black stitched bound edge and black corner hanging loop. Reference 1 orange/rust; reference 2 gray. Single cloth design.
products.generationConstraints: Use one consistent shown color across generated hero/usecase. Do not imply both colors supplied as a two-pack.

products.title: Reusable Bag Locking Ties — Set of 3
products.physicalInvariants: Three flexible loop ties: long paired rails and a large circular finger ring with rounded sliding lock. Yellow loop/blue lock, green loop/magenta lock, purple loop/orange lock visible.
products.generationConstraints: Hero exactly three ties; props bread/cookies not included. Reference 2 shows color alternatives; preserve first image set rather than inventing a four-pack.

products.title: Compact Cable Winder Case
products.physicalInvariants: Blue round hinged clamshell cable-winder case, raised circular central winding hub with split semicircular top and a straight slot, edge cable notches and hinge tab. One case.

products.title: Window Groove Cleaning Brush

products.title: Foldable Hanging Travel Organizer

products.generationConstraints: Toiletries/medicines/razor are props; do not imply included. Preserve actual pocket layout and cream color.

products.title: Flexible Flower-Shaped Drain Catcher
products.physicalInvariants: Lime green flower-shaped shallow drain basket, scalloped petals, perforated round inner bowl, central small upright stem ending in spherical grip. One flexible-looking catcher.
products.generationConstraints: Preserve scallops, perforated bowl and center stem. Do not flatten into a generic mat or add suction cups not shown.

products.title: 3-in-1 Bottle Lid Cleaning Tool
products.physicalInvariants: Orange folding flat handle with rounded end, raised circular grip dots, hanging cutout; green straight bristles at one end, white fold-out narrow scraper, loop-shaped wire brush with white bristles at other end. One three-part tool.
products.generationConstraints: Preserve all three cleaning implements and fold pivot. Bottle/lid are props; no extra detachable tool set.

products.title: Adhesive Cable Organizer Clips — Set of 20
products.physicalInvariants: Cream long rounded rectangular strip with decorative rounded ends and five flower-shaped raised cable guides, forming cable gaps along strip. Inset shows twenty matching strips arranged five rows of four.
products.generationConstraints: Product set count 20 refers to whole strips, not 20 individual flowers; cables are props. Hero count needs exact pack count if showing all units; single strip plus stack can underrepresent count, so prefer 20 clear strips.

products.title: Household Wiping Cloths — Set of 3
products.physicalInvariants: Three rectangular woven wiping cloths: pink/red stripes, green/yellow stripes, cream/brown flower motif, white bound edges. Visible first-image inset shows two pink-dominant and one green-dominant cloth.
products.generationConstraints: Exactly three cloths for hero. Preserve woven stripes/floral band; do not change into plain microfiber or make four by counting usecase cloth plus background stack.

products.generationConstraints: Bra/laundry and washer are props. Preserve cylindrical form/blue mesh lid; do not convert to flat mesh envelope.

products.title: Keyboard Cover

products.generationConstraints: Reference 2 establishes flat sheet; do not generate a molded keycap cover, keyboard or desktop dust bag. Keyboard is prop; no universal exact-layout claim. Remove packaging text from output.
